summary: The change correctly retains the raw catalog body for 304 revalidation and adds a regression test for narrowing windows.

evidence: src/catalog/store.ts stores the original input body separately and loads it as source_body.
src/catalog/index.ts revalidates from source_body and avoids sending validators for legacy caches without retained source data.
tests/openrouter-catalog.test.ts covers widening followed by 304 revalidation after a narrower OpenRouter value.
